title: SecretDGX node set
description: Describes ~/Library/Application Support/secretdgx/nodes.json — the authorized node list consumed at runtime by the dock apps (NodeConfig.all loader in Sources/main.swift) and by the shell scripts. Setup wizard (setup_wizard.sh) writes this file; an AI agent OR human instantiating the repo for a new environment can author it by hand instead of running the wizard, provided SSH + the dock key (~/.ssh/id_secretdgx) are already in place.

name.description: Node identity. Flows into bundle id (local.secretdgx.SecretDGX-<name>), the .app bundle name, and the --node argument. Restricted to a safe charset because it becomes a file/executable name.

user.description: SSH login user on the node. Any account with nvidia-smi access works ('nvidia' on a stock DGX Spark, 'a'/'a3' on some fleets, any admin account on a workstation).

ip.description: Node LAN IP. Direct nodes use user@ip to SSH.

host.description: Host address — equals ip for direct nodes; kept for the jump/indirect case.

group.description: Informational fleet name (e.g. 'r', 'a', 'a3'). Does not select a key — the fleet shares one dock key.

source.description: How discovery found the node. cosmetic.

reachable.description: True when the SSH path answered a probe at discovery time.

authOk.description: True when the dock key authenticates on this node. Runtime icons only render for authorized nodes.

isDgx.description: True for DGX Spark / NVIDIA boxes (ran nvidia-smi). Label only, not a gate — any nvidia-smi host appears (e.g. an RTX 6000 workstation).

indirectVia.description: Present only for nodes behind a jump host. SSH target becomes 'sdgx-<name>' resolved through ~/.ssh/config.secretdgx (which carries the ProxyJump). The hop leg authenticates with the user's normal key.

oneOf.title: indirect node (behind jump)
oneOf.description: sshHost = sdgx-<name> resolved via config.secretdgx ProxyJump
